The genome is the complete set of an organism's DNA, spanning all of its chromosomes (and organellar DNA such as mitochondrial DNA, where present), so neither offered option is fully correct. The note's claim that a single chromosome defines the genome is wrong, since one chromosome is only part of it, and the protein set is the proteome, not the genome. The original question ends at "The genome is:", so if you meant a specific completion, send the full wording and I'll check it against this.

CONFIDENCE: 72
